job.title: DevOps Engineer - £55k - £60k - AWS
job.description:
Mid-Level DevOps & Platform Engineer
Location: UK Remote (Travel roughly 1 day every 1–2 months to London or Manchester)
Salary: £55,000 – £60,000 + Benefits

About the Opportunity

Our client is an established, high-growth UK SaaS business providing critical safeguarding and medical management software across thousands of schools and education trusts nationwide. Operating a modern AWS stack, they are expanding their platform capabilities and deploying a brand-new cloud region in the UAE alongside their core UK setup.
They are looking for a hands-on Mid-Level DevOps / Platform Engineer with 2–3 years of experience who is eager to learn, adapt, and grow within a close-knit engineering team. Initially reporting to the Head of Engineering, you will transition under the direct line management and mentorship of the DevOps Lead.

This is a versatile, high-visibility role where you will support both cloud infrastructure and internal IT/SysOps. The architecture, pipelines, and frameworks are already established by the DevOps Lead—your role is to help implement, maintain, pair-review, and contribute to continuous platform improvements.

Key Responsibilities
  • Cloud Platform & Execution: Implement AWS infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines alongside the DevOps Lead, taking designs through to production through pair reviews and code releases.
  • UAE Region Expansion: Assist with the AWS deployment and DevOps work required to stand up the new UAE cloud region.
  • Internal Systems & IT Management: Manage internal IT operations, staff onboarding, and device endpoints using Jamf (macOS MDM), Microsoft 365, and Google Workspace.
  • Internal Escalation Support: Serve as the internal technical contact for platform and infrastructure fixes to support internal teams and onboarding (no out-of-hours or direct customer support required).
  • Process & Tooling Improvement: Help automate manual tasks, streamline GitHub Actions workflows, and refine monitoring and operational guardrails.
Essential Skills & Experience (Non-Negotiables)
  • 2–3 Years DevOps / Infrastructure Experience: Proven hands-on background in a DevOps or Platform role working with CI/CD tools and code pipelines.
  • AWS Certification: Must hold an AWS Associate-level certification (e.g., AWS Certified SysOps Administrator, Solutions Architect Associate, or DevOps Engineer Associate).
  • Core AWS & Cloud Skills: Solid foundation in core AWS services, networking, IAM fundamentals, and command-line/scripting.
  • Small-Team Adaptability: Experience working in smaller engineering teams or scale-up environments—comfortable "spinning plates," taking initiative, and learning on the job.
  • Open Mindset to IT & Platform: A collaborative, open approach to handling both cloud platform work and internal IT/Jamf endpoint management without being rigid about "how things must be done".
  • Flexible Travel: Comfortable travelling roughly 1 day per month (or every 2 months) to meet the team in either London or Manchester.
Desirable Skills (Nice-to-Have)
  • Hands-on experience or familiarity with Jamf for macOS MDM management.
  • Exposure to Terraform, AWS CDK, or TypeScript/Node.js tooling.
  • Exposure to multi-region setups (e.g., UAE rollout) or observability tools like New Relic.
Key Benefits
  • Salary range: £55,000 – £60,000.
  • Mostly UK remote working setup (1 day every 1–2 months in London/Manchester).
  • Direct line management and 1:1 mentorship from the DevOps Lead.
  • No out-of-hours / on-call requirements—focusing strictly on internal support and platform growth.
  • High-trust, supportive environment with genuine long-term career progression.
  To find out more apply for the position

job.title: Staff Machine Learning Scientist
job.description:
Staff Machine Learning Scientist | Core ML | UK (Hybrid)

 Location: London | Type: Permanent

Salary: £100,000–£120,000 per annum

The Company

Our client is an established, tech-driven digital platform with an international footprint and millions of active users. Operating independently as part of a global group, they combine an agile, engineering-led culture with the backing and resources of a major parent business.

The Role

This is a high-visibility opportunity for an experienced Machine Learning Scientist to join a newly formed Core ML team and shape technical direction from day one. Reporting directly to the new Senior ML Engineering Manager, you will work closely with leadership to establish core architecture and team standards.

As a Staff Machine Learning Scientist, you will build foundational models that serve multiple engineering and product verticals—focusing on representation learning, visual embeddings, and generalized automated classifiers.

In this role, each Machine Learning Scientist on the team will look to you for technical strategy, complex engineering leadership, and mentorship while you collaborate directly with Product Managers, ML Engineers, and Data Scientists.

What You'll Do
  • Design, build, and deploy ML systems addressing multi-faceted platform challenges.
  • Develop and fine-tune models for representation learning, vision tasks, and core classification, scaling them as shared services.
  • Partner with senior stakeholders to define technical roadmaps for automated content understanding, risk/trust systems, and personalization.
  • Drive large-scale, end-to-end experiment design—from initial hypothesis to production evaluation and business impact assessment.
  • Evaluate emerging research, contribute to long-term data strategy, and foster engineering best practices across teams.
  • Lead technical whiteboarding, architectural reviews, and roadmap planning sessions.
  • Translate complex machine learning concepts into actionable strategy for cross-functional leadership.
What You'll Bring
  • A track record of shipping and scaling ML models with measurable commercial impact
  • Deep ML knowledge applied in production, using PyTorch, TensorFlow or Transformers
  • Strong, production-quality Python, plus solid data engineering and MLOps foundations
  • Experience owning ML initiatives end to end, working through ambiguity, and mentoring others
  • Strong collaboration skills across multi-functional teams
  • Real curiosity about AI and how it can improve the way you work
Nice to Have
  • NLP, image classification, deep learning or LLM experience
  • A/B testing and experiment design
  • Experience building platform-style or shared ML systems
  • Databricks and PySpark
  • AWS, GCP or Azure
Interested? If you're an experienced Machine Learning Scientist ready to take on this challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

Get in touch: max@neartechsearch.com

job.title: AI Software Engineer
job.description:
AI Software Engineer
£70k-90k + Equity Options
  
UK Remote | Full-time
A well-funded startup is looking for an AI Software Engineer to build and improve systems that process complex data inputs for enterprise clients, delivering reliable, actionable insights. You'll work with a lean, experienced team who care about getting things right.
  
What You'd Do
  • Own the full technical stack as an AI Software Engineer: data processing, routing logic, model integration, external service connections, and output assembly
  • Take features from concept to production and monitor real-world performance
  • Identify accuracy gaps and solve them across the stack (data quality, prompts, model selection, or replacing ML with logic where it makes sense)
  • Connect third-party services reliably and fail gracefully when they don't work
  • Create test suites and metrics that validate your changes
  • Handle client-specific configurations without creating maintenance nightmares
  • Get direct feedback from end users about how your work gets used
  
What They're Looking For
  
  • 5+ years building software; substantial recent experience with production LLM systems
  • Strong Python skills (3.10+); comfortable building resilient, asynchronous workflows using cloud function frameworks
  • Experience building and deploying agentic systems using LLM abstraction layers, with hands-on work across multiple model providers (Gemini, Claude, etc.)
  • Proficiency with vector embeddings and retrieval optimization for AI pipelines
  • Experience containerising applications (Docker) and managing infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or similar)
  • Comfortable working across cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) and integrating with services/APIs written in other languages (particularly Node.js)
  • You have opinions about what should be handled by models vs. what belongs in code
  • You've written test data, defined success metrics, and seen them catch real issues
  • You validate your own work critically before others do
  • You investigate what data the model is actually seeing before tweaking prompts
  • You identify gaps and propose solutions without needing a task list
  • Able to lead technical discussions with enterprise customers — explaining complex AI architecture with clarity and confidence
  
Team & Environment
  • Fully remote, small core team
  • Focus on shipping incrementally and learning from real usage
  • Individual ownership of projects from design through deployment
  • Lightweight processes that stay out of your way
  • Regular input from the people who depend on your code
  
Interested? Get in touch and let's discuss what they're building and what the AI Software Engineer role involves.
